name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: stop stale cross-imports into old bootstrap bundles that could initialize the GUI twice and trigger the GitHub/error screen
reduce console/DOM overhead on heavy admin pages such as Datenpunkte, Module, Dienste, Hosts and Systemlogs
allow expert specific-version installation button for installed adapters even when repository metadata blocks normal auto-update controls
protect only eos-admin.0 from deletion; eos-admin.1 and other additional EOS Admin test instances become deletable again
keep native ioBroker datapoint semantics: common.write=false read-only, common.write!=false opens native write dialog
preserve delete/logquiet/role/datapoint fixes from previous versions
notes: Stability cleanup for v54-v57 cached bundles, heavy-page branding throttling, instance-aware EOS Admin delete protection, and expert version install fix.
description: Keeps the EOS design while preventing old admin bundles from reinitializing the app and restoring expected admin operations.
